# The never-raise guards every `except Exception` in the three guard files, keyed by FILE, FUNCTION and the SITE NAME
# its first call records (`_guard_failed("<site>")` in guard/diagnostic.py, `record(Site.<site>)` elsewhere). No line numbers: tests/test_never_raise_guards.py
# parses the source (ast) and requires this list and the code to hold exactly the same (file, function, site) rows, so a guard that is
# swapped, moved to another function, added or removed fails the test. A site "-" records nothing: a conversion, not a guard.
# file	function	site	why it cannot be narrowed	test
src/hadavin_sdk/guard/diagnostic.py	_is_the_named_class	named_class	reads __module__, __qualname__ and vars() of a class a hostile program built; a property or metaclass there may raise any Exception	test_diagnostic_guards.py::test_guard_catches_and_records[named_class]
src/hadavin_sdk/guard/diagnostic.py	class_name_of	class_name	calls the check above on an object the caller supplied; any Exception from its attributes must give dynamic_class	test_diagnostic_guards.py::test_guard_catches_and_records[class_name]
src/hadavin_sdk/guard/diagnostic.py	_own_match	own_code	walks the class chain of a hostile exception; one class with a raising attribute must not hide the rest	test_diagnostic_guards.py::test_guard_catches_and_records[own_code]
src/hadavin_sdk/guard/diagnostic.py	_provider_facts	provider_attrs	vars() of a provider error that a hostile program built (unpickled or assigned); a property or __getattr__ there may raise any Exception	test_diagnostic_guards.py::test_guard_catches_and_records[provider_attrs]
src/hadavin_sdk/guard/diagnostic.py	_counted_module	counted_module	reads f_globals, co_filename of a frame object taken from a traceback a hostile program can build	test_diagnostic_guards.py::test_guard_catches_and_records[counted_module]
src/hadavin_sdk/guard/diagnostic.py	_locate	locator	reads f_code of the same hostile frame objects	test_diagnostic_guards.py::test_guard_catches_and_records[locator]
src/hadavin_sdk/guard/diagnostic.py	validation_text	validation_text	calls pydantic error methods on an object that only claims to be a ValidationError	test_diagnostic_guards.py::test_guard_catches_and_records[validation_text]
src/hadavin_sdk/guard/diagnostic.py	_classify	group_member	reads .exceptions of an exception group subclass; a property there may raise any Exception	test_diagnostic_guards.py::test_guard_catches_and_records[group_member]
src/hadavin_sdk/guard/diagnostic.py	_is_provider_subclass	provider_class	reads __module__ and __qualname__ of each class in a hostile exception's MRO; one class with a raising attribute must not hide the rest	test_diagnostic_guards.py::test_guard_catches_and_records[provider_class]
src/hadavin_sdk/guard/diagnostic.py	diagnose	diagnose	the last net around the whole classifier: a diagnostic must come back whatever the exception object does	test_diagnostic_guards.py::test_guard_catches_and_records[diagnose]
src/hadavin_sdk/guard/diagnostic.py	render	render	reads fields of a Diagnostic that a caller may have forged; the line must come back	test_diagnostic_guards.py::test_guard_catches_and_records[render]
src/hadavin_sdk/llm/provider_facts.py	safe_attr	facts_safe_attr	getattr on a provider error with a hostile property can raise any Exception	test_never_raise_guards.py::test_provider_facts_guards_catch_record_and_let_base_exceptions_through
src/hadavin_sdk/llm/provider_facts.py	safe_facts	facts_adapter_hook	an adapter hook (anthropic/bedrock/default facts) is foreign-shaped code reading foreign objects; any Exception is possible	test_never_raise_guards.py::test_provider_facts_guards_catch_record_and_let_base_exceptions_through
src/hadavin_sdk/llm/retry.py	describe	retry_class_text	class_name_of is declared never-raise; this is the belt-and-braces fallback if that contract is ever broken (tested by replacing it)	test_never_raise_guards.py::test_retry_guards_catch_record_and_let_base_exceptions_through
src/hadavin_sdk/llm/retry.py	_close_failed_http	retry_close_failed_http	HTTPError.close() on a subclass with hostile code can raise any Exception; it must never replace the real provider error	test_never_raise_guards.py::test_retry_guards_catch_record_and_let_base_exceptions_through
src/hadavin_sdk/llm/retry.py	with_retry	-	the call is foreign code and can raise anything; this handler is the ordinary failure path (a 429, a reset connection) and records nothing, so the counters show faults only; every path out of it is a retry or a ProviderError/ProviderExhausted	test_never_raise_guards.py::test_an_ordinary_retried_failure_is_not_counted_and_a_genuine_fault_is
src/hadavin_sdk/llm/retry.py	with_retry	retry_decision	the transient/retryable test is foreign-shaped; a crash is booked as the billed class (the request was sent)	test_never_raise_guards.py::test_retry_guards_catch_record_and_let_base_exceptions_through
src/hadavin_sdk/llm/retry.py	with_retry	retry_wait	retry_after reads a foreign response header; a crash is booked as the billed class (no extra request)	test_never_raise_guards.py::test_retry_guards_catch_record_and_let_base_exceptions_through
